footnotes: Condensed-film sensible heat below each crossing is neglected relative to latent heat.
Cold-end work uses the seven-node Claude cycle; dry-expander shaft credit is explicit.
Cryogenic sizing is the night-path-only case; day-operation strategy remains deferred.
Melt-offgas O2 sensible duty is charged through S-A to 1000 K, then enters S-B at that post-separator datum.
SiO/CrO2 condenser enthalpy is not sourced in Phase 1a; exclusions are classified without reusing melt-side reaction enthalpy.
Cold-end capacity C is the minimum of compressor mass-flow and refrigeration freeze-rate ratings; the orifice is derived from C.
All kg and USD values are report-edge projections; internal enthalpy arithmetic is mol/s and W.
Hot and mid radiator sections conservatively sum per-species design maxima; the displayed hot peak is a concurrent snapshot maximum.

Reviewed b-878 value retained. Direct high-supersaturation growth is near unity in Tachibana et al. 2011, ApJ 736:16, p. 6 Fig. 6 and section 4.2; applying the 2001 fit to this collector remains an inference. reported_activity_provenance.melt_oxide_gamma_limitation: constant_gamma_table_value with endmember continuity shell starting at asserted X=0.99; gamma is a shipped mid-range constant (CaO/Al2O3/SiO2/TiO2/Cr2O3/MgO/MnO: rounded geometric midpoint of the Sossi & Fegley 2018 Table 2 printed envelope, not a cited point coefficient; Na2O/K2O: cited point anchors); no one-parameter pseudo-binary mid-range regular solution and no A*T*/T temperature scaling of gamma (held for multi-component G^E / MC-5); as X approaches 1 the shell enforces Raoultian a->1 continuously so the former gamma*X to a=1 step (31.1x for Cr) is absent; when valid_range_K is set, a temperature outside that interval remains flux-driving and status-bearing; when valid_range_K is unset, this module attaches no in_domain/out_of_gamma_domain payload

reported_activity_provenance.melt_oxide_gamma_limitation: constant_gamma_table_value with endmember continuity shell starting at asserted X=0.99; gamma is a shipped mid-range constant (CaO/Al2O3/SiO2/TiO2/Cr2O3/MgO/MnO: rounded geometric midpoint of the Sossi & Fegley 2018 Table 2 printed envelope, not a cited point coefficient; Na2O/K2O: cited point anchors); no one-parameter pseudo-binary mid-range regular solution and no A*T*/T temperature scaling of gamma (held for multi-component G^E / MC-5); as X approaches 1 the shell enforces Raoultian a->1 continuously so the former gamma*X to a=1 step (31.1x for Cr) is absent; when valid_range_K is set, a temperature outside that interval remains flux-driving and status-bearing; when valid_range_K is unset, this module attaches no in_domain/out_of_gamma_domain payload

stage_0_to_stage_1.source: Tachibana, Nagahara & Ozawa 2001, LPSC XXXII #1767, p. 2 Fig. 1: pure-Fe condensation coefficient inferred from Fe-pellet backreaction; their fit assumes alpha_c = alpha_e at the measured interface. Reviewed b-878 value retained. Direct high-supersaturation growth is near unity in Tachibana et al. 2011, ApJ 736:16, p. 6 Fig. 6 and section 4.2; applying the 2001 fit to this collector remains an inference. The Costa & Jacobson olivine figure-only alpha withdrawn in kems-007-costa-2015 is not condensation evidence.

stage_0_to_stage_1.source: Tachibana, Nagahara & Ozawa 2001, LPSC XXXII #1767, p. 2 Fig. 1: pure-Fe condensation coefficient inferred from Fe-pellet backreaction; their fit assumes alpha_c = alpha_e at the measured interface. Reviewed b-878 value retained. Direct high-supersaturation growth is near unity in Tachibana et al. 2011, ApJ 736:16, p. 6 Fig. 6 and section 4.2; applying the 2001 fit to this collector remains an inference. The Costa & Jacobson olivine figure-only alpha withdrawn in kems-007-costa-2015 is not condensation evidence.

stage_0_to_stage_1.source: Tachibana, Nagahara & Ozawa 2001, LPSC XXXII #1767, p. 2 Fig. 1: pure-Fe condensation coefficient inferred from Fe-pellet backreaction; their fit assumes alpha_c = alpha_e at the measured interface. Reviewed b-878 value retained. Direct high-supersaturation growth is near unity in Tachibana et al. 2011, ApJ 736:16, p. 6 Fig. 6 and section 4.2; applying the 2001 fit to this collector remains an inference. The Costa & Jacobson olivine figure-only alpha withdrawn in kems-007-costa-2015 is not condensation evidence.

Reviewed b-878 value retained. Direct high-supersaturation growth is near unity in Tachibana et al. 2011, ApJ 736:16, p. 6 Fig. 6 and section 4.2; applying the 2001 fit to this collector remains an inference. The Costa & Jacobson olivine figure-only alpha withdrawn in kems-007-costa-2015 is not condensation evidence.

reported_activity_provenance.melt_oxide_gamma_citation: Sossi & Fegley 2018 Table 2 pp.409-410, DOI 10.2138/rmg.2018.84.11; runtime 1.60 is the rounded geometric midpoint of the printed TiO2 range 1.5-1.7 at 1573-1773 K (CMAS; Ghiorso & Sack 1995), not a single Table 2 coefficient
reported_activity_provenance.melt_oxide_gamma_limitation: constant_gamma_table_value with endmember continuity shell starting at asserted X=0.99; gamma is a shipped mid-range constant (CaO/Al2O3/SiO2/TiO2/Cr2O3/MgO/MnO: rounded geometric midpoint of the Sossi & Fegley 2018 Table 2 printed envelope, not a cited point coefficient; Na2O/K2O: cited point anchors); no one-parameter pseudo-binary mid-range regular solution and no A*T*/T temperature scaling of gamma (held for multi-component G^E / MC-5); as X approaches 1 the shell enforces Raoultian a->1 continuously so the former gamma*X to a=1 step (31.1x for Cr) is absent; when valid_range_K is set, a temperature outside that interval remains flux-driving and status-bearing; when valid_range_K is unset, this module attaches no in_domain/out_of_gamma_domain payload

Reviewed b-878 value retained. Direct high-supersaturation growth is near unity in Tachibana et al. 2011, ApJ 736:16, p. 6 Fig. 6 and section 4.2; applying the 2001 fit to this collector remains an inference. The Costa & Jacobson olivine figure-only alpha withdrawn in kems-007-costa-2015 is not condensation evidence.

Reviewed b-878 value retained. Direct high-supersaturation growth is near unity in Tachibana et al. 2011, ApJ 736:16, p. 6 Fig. 6 and section 4.2; applying the 2001 fit to this collector remains an inference. The Costa & Jacobson olivine figure-only alpha withdrawn in kems-007-costa-2015 is not condensation evidence.
